name: Графік відключень
description: Графік ДТЕК, фактична наявність світла за розеткою та заряд станції.
template:
<Stack p={7} gap={4}>
  <Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap={6}>
    <Group wrap="nowrap" gap={7} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <ThemeIcon size={28} radius="md" variant="light" color="yellow">
        <Icon name="calendar-time" size={16} />
      </ThemeIcon>
      <Stack gap={1} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Text size="sm" lh={1.15} fw={700}>Відключення</Text>
        <Text fz={11} lh={1.2} c="dimmed" truncate>ДТЕК Київщина · Черга {options.queue}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <RefreshButton />
  </Group>

  {status.schedule?.ok === false && !status.schedule.loading ? (
    <Paper p={8} radius="md" bg="var(--mantine-color-red-light)">
      <Text size="xs" fw={700}>
        {status.schedule.status === 401 ? "Потрібні облікові дані" :
         status.schedule.status === 400 ? "Перевір номер черги" : "Графік недоступний"}
      </Text>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        {status.schedule.status === 401 ? "Перевір Basic Auth у джерелі віджета." :
         status.schedule.status === 400 ? "Вкажи номер черги у форматі 4.1." :
         status.schedule.status === 404 ? "Онови Power Dashboard для цього віджета." :
         status.schedule.status ? "Power Dashboard · HTTP " + status.schedule.status : "Перевір з’єднання з Power Dashboard."}
      </Text>
    </Paper>
  ) : !data.schedule ? (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Skeleton h={28} radius="md" />
      <Skeleton h={66} radius="md" />
    </Stack>
  ) : [data.schedule].map(overview => ({
    today: overview.today,
    dates: (overview.widgetDays ?? overview.days).map(day => ({
      value: day.date,
      label: day.date < overview.today ? "Вчора" : day.date === overview.today ? "Сьогодні" : day.date === overview.tomorrow ? "Завтра" :
        day.date.slice(8, 10) + "." + day.date.slice(5, 7)
    })),
    day: (overview.widgetDays ?? overview.days).find(day => day.date === inputs.day) ?? (overview.widgetDays ?? overview.days).find(day => day.date === overview.today),
    selectedCharge: (overview.widgetDays ?? overview.days).find(day => day.date === inputs.day)?.charge ?? (inputs.day == null || inputs.day === overview.today ? overview.charge : null),
    selectedPower: (overview.widgetDays ?? overview.days).find(day => day.date === inputs.day)?.power ?? (inputs.day == null || inputs.day === overview.today ? overview.power : null),
    powerColors: { online: "light-dark(#145c45, #a1e3c5)", offline: "light-dark(#a4272e, #ffb8b6)", unknown: "light-dark(#516170, #aebdca)" },
    powerLabels: { online: "Світло є", offline: "Світла немає", unknown: "Невідомо" },
    checked: overview.lastSuccessfulPollAt ?
      Date.toLocaleString(overview.lastSuccessfulPollAt, "lt-LT", "Europe/Kyiv") : null,
    stale: overview.stale,
    colors: {
      power: "light-dark(#ffffff, #1a222d)",
      outage: "light-dark(#d9dce1, #4b535e)",
      possible: "light-dark(#e7edf3, #283440)",
      unknown: "light-dark(#e7edf3, #283440)",
      charge: "light-dark(#145941, #9de6c9)"
    },
    labels: { power: "Зі світлом", outage: "Без світла", possible: "Можливе", unknown: "Без даних" }
  })).map(view => (
    <Stack key="overview" gap={4}>
      {view.dates.length <= 3 ? (
        <SegmentedControl fullWidth size="xs" color="teal" transitionDuration={0} aria-label="День відключень"
          bind="day" defaultValue={view.today} resetKey={view.today} data={view.dates} />
      ) : (
        <Select size="xs" aria-label="День відключень" allowDeselect={false}
          bind="day" defaultValue={view.today} resetKey={view.today} data={view.dates} />
      )}

      <Group justify="space-between" align="baseline" gap={4} wrap="nowrap">
        <Text fz={10} lh={1.2} c={view.day.status === "EmergencyShutdowns" ? "red" : "dimmed"} truncate>
          {view.day.next ? (view.day.next.ongoing ? "Зараз " : "Далі ") + view.day.next.range :
            { ScheduleApplies: "Діє графік", EmergencyShutdowns: "Аварійні відключення", NoShutdowns: "Без планових",
              WaitingForSchedule: "Очікується графік" }[view.day.status ?? ""] ?? "Графік не опубліковано"}
        </Text>
        {view.day.date <= view.today ? (
          view.selectedCharge ? (
            <Text fz={10} lh={1.2} fw={700} c={view.colors.charge} title={"Вимір о " + view.selectedCharge.last.time}>
              Заряд {view.selectedCharge.last.socPct}%
            </Text>
          ) : <Text fz={10} lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Заряд недоступний</Text>
        ) : null}
      </Group>

      {view.selectedCharge ? (
        <Stack gap={3} style={{ flexShrink: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <Box h={66} style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "28px minmax(0, 1fr)", gridTemplateRows: "minmax(0, 1fr)", minWidth: 0, overflow: "hidden", flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <Group gap={0} wrap="nowrap" aria-hidden="true" style={{ gridColumn: "2", gridRow: "1", overflow: "hidden", paddingRight: 5 }}>
              {view.selectedCharge.bands.map(band => <Box key={band.start} h="100%" w={(band.end - band.start) / view.selectedCharge.duration * 100 + "%"}
                bg={band.kind === "possible" ? view.colors.possible : undefined}
                style={band.kind === "possible" ? { backgroundImage: "repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 4px, light-dark(#dce3e9, #334353) 4px 6px)" } : {}} />)}
            </Group>
          <LineChart h={66} style={{ gridColumn: "1 / 3", gridRow: "1" }} data={view.selectedCharge.points} dataKey="minute"
            aria-label="Історія заряду на тлі графіка відключень та стану розетки"
            series={[{ name: "socPct", label: "Заряд", color: view.colors.charge }]}
            withXAxis={false} xAxisProps={{ type: "number", domain: [0, view.selectedCharge.duration], allowDataOverflow: true }}
            unit="%" yAxisProps={{ domain: [0, 100], ticks: [25, 50, 75], width: 28, tick: { fontSize: 9, fill: "currentColor" } }}
            curveType="linear" connectNulls={false} withTooltip={false} withDots={false}
            strokeWidth={1.6} gridAxis="y"
            referenceAreas={(view.selectedCharge.backgrounds ?? view.selectedCharge.bands).map(band => ({
              x1: band.start, x2: band.end, color: band.layer === "power" ? view.powerColors[band.kind] : view.colors[band.kind],
              fillOpacity: band.layer === "power" ? (band.kind === "offline" ? 0.2 : 0.12) : band.kind === "possible" ? 0 : 1, strokeOpacity: 0
            }))}
            referenceLines={view.day.date === view.today ? [{ x: view.selectedCharge.now, color: "var(--mantine-color-dimmed)", strokeDasharray: "3 3" }] : []}
            referenceDots={[{ x: view.selectedCharge.last.minute, y: view.selectedCharge.last.socPct, r: 2, color: view.colors.charge }]} />
            <Group gap={0} wrap="nowrap" aria-hidden="true" style={{ gridColumn: "2", gridRow: "1", overflow: "hidden", paddingRight: 5 }}>
              {view.selectedCharge.bands.map(band => <Box key={band.start} h="100%" w={(band.end - band.start) / view.selectedCharge.duration * 100 + "%"}
                c="light-dark(#19232d, #e8eff5)" style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", overflow: "hidden", opacity: 0.7 }}>
                {band.kind === "outage" ? <Icon name="bolt-off" size={14} style={{ maxWidth: "100%" }} /> : null}
              </Box>)}
            </Group>
          </Box>
          <Group pl={28} pr={3} justify="space-between" gap={2} wrap="nowrap">
            {view.selectedCharge.ticks.map((time, index) => <Text key={index} fz={9} lh={1} c="dimmed">{time}</Text>)}
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      ) : (
        <Stack gap={3}>
          <Group gap={0} wrap="nowrap" style={{ borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden" }}>
            {view.day.intervals.map(interval => (
              <Tooltip key={interval.start} label={interval.range + " · " + view.labels[interval.kind]}
                events={{ hover: true, focus: true, touch: true }}>
                <Box h={20} w={(interval.end - interval.start) / 1440 * 100 + "%"} bg={view.colors[interval.kind]}
                  c="light-dark(#19232d, #e8eff5)"
                  style={interval.kind === "possible" ? {
                    display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", overflow: "hidden",
                    backgroundImage: "repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 4px, light-dark(#dce3e9, #334353) 4px 6px)"
                  } : { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", overflow: "hidden" }}
                  role="img" tabIndex={0} aria-label={interval.range + " · " + view.labels[interval.kind]}>
                  {interval.kind === "outage" ? <Icon name="bolt-off" size={14} style={{ maxWidth: "100%", opacity: 0.7 }} /> : null}
                </Box>
              </Tooltip>
            ))}
          </Group>
          <Group justify="space-between" gap={2} wrap="nowrap">
            {["00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "24:00"].map(time => <Text key={time} fz={9} lh={1} c="dimmed">{time}</Text>)}
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      )}

      {view.day.date <= view.today ? (
        <Stack gap={3}>
          <Group justify="space-between" gap={4}>
            <Text fz={10} lh={1.1} c="dimmed">За розеткою</Text>
            {view.day.date === view.today ? <Badge size="xs" variant="light" color={view.selectedPower?.current?.status === "online" ? "teal" : view.selectedPower?.current?.status === "offline" ? "red" : "gray"}>
              {view.selectedPower?.current?.status === "online" ? "Світло є" : view.selectedPower?.current?.status === "offline" ? "Світла немає" : "Стан невідомий"}
            </Badge> : null}
          </Group>
          {!view.selectedCharge && view.selectedPower?.bands?.length ? (
            <Group gap={0} wrap="nowrap" style={{ borderRadius: 3, overflow: "hidden" }}>
              {view.selectedPower.bands.map(band => <Box key={band.start} h={8} w={(band.end - band.start) / view.selectedPower.duration * 100 + "%"} bg={view.powerColors[band.kind]} title={view.powerLabels[band.kind]} />)}
            </Group>
          ) : null}
          <Group gap={5}>
            {["online", "offline", "unknown"].map(kind => <Group key={kind} gap={3} wrap="nowrap"><Box w={7} h={7} bg={view.powerColors[kind]} style={{ borderRadius: 2 }} /><Text fz={10} lh={1.1} c="dimmed">{view.powerLabels[kind]}</Text></Group>)}
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      ) : null}

      <Group gap={5}>
        {["power", "outage", "possible", "unknown"].filter(kind =>
          kind !== "unknown" || view.day.intervals.some(interval => interval.kind === "unknown")
        ).map(kind => (
          <Group key={kind} gap={3} wrap="nowrap">
            <Box w={7} h={7} bg={view.colors[kind]} style={kind === "possible" ? {
              border: "1px solid var(--mantine-color-default-border)", borderRadius: 2,
              backgroundImage: "repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 4px, light-dark(#dce3e9, #334353) 4px 6px)"
            } : { border: "1px solid var(--mantine-color-default-border)", borderRadius: 2 }} />
            <Text fz={10} lh={1.1} c="dimmed">{view.labels[kind]}</Text>
          </Group>
        ))}
      </Group>

      <Group justify="space-between" gap={4}>
        <Text fz={10} lh={1.2} c="dimmed" title={view.checked ? view.checked + " · Київ" : undefined}>
          {view.checked ? "Перевірено " + view.checked.slice(11, 16) + " · Київ" : "Очікуємо дані ДТЕК"}
        </Text>
        {view.stale ? <Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="yellow">Графік застарів</Badge> : null}
      </Group>
    </Stack>
  ))}
</Stack>
